# Vapi

Vapi is a voice AI platform that enables developers to build, test, and deploy voice agents with natural conversations, real-time responses, and seamless integration capabilities.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vapi/.

## Actions

- **Create Analytics Queries** (read-only): Create and execute analytics queries on VAPI data.
- **Create Assistant**: Create a new Vapi assistant with specified transcriber, voice, and AI model configurations.
- **Create Monitoring Policy**: Create a monitoring policy in VAPI.
- **Create Session**: Create a new session in Vapi.
- **Delete Eval**: Delete an eval by ID.
- **Delete Phone Number**: Delete a phone number from Vapi.
- **Get Call** (read-only): Fetch call details by ID.
- **Get Chat** (read-only): Fetch chat details by ID.
- **Get File** (read-only): Retrieve a file by its ID from Vapi.
- **Get Tool** (read-only): Fetch tool details by ID.
- **List Calls** (read-only): List calls from Vapi.
- **List Chats** (read-only): Retrieve a list of chat conversations from VAPI.
- **List Evals** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of evals from Vapi.
- **List Monitoring Policies** (read-only): Retrieve monitoring policies from Vapi.
- **List Provider Resources** (read-only): Retrieve provider resources from Vapi (e.g., 11labs pronunciation dictionaries).
- **Update Assistant**: Update an existing Vapi assistant configuration.
- **Update Phone Number**: Update an existing phone number configuration in VAPI.
- **Create Eval**: Create an eval for testing conversation flows.
- **Create OpenAI Chat**: Create an OpenAI-compatible chat using the Vapi API.
- **Create Phone Number**: Create a phone number with Vapi.
- **Create Phone Number**: Create a phone number with VAPI.
- **Create Provider Resource**: Create an 11Labs pronunciation dictionary resource.
- **Create Scorecard**: Create a scorecard for observability and evaluation.
- **Delete Call**: Delete a call by its unique identifier.
- **Delete Chat**: Delete a chat by its ID from Vapi.
- **Delete Eval Run**: Delete an eval run by its ID from Vapi.
- **Get Assistant** (read-only): Retrieve a specific assistant by ID from Vapi.
- **Get Eval** (read-only): Retrieve an eval by its ID.
- **Get Insights** (read-only): Retrieve insights from Vapi.
- **Get Insights** (read-only): Retrieve insights from VAPI.
- **Get Observability Scorecard**: List observability scorecards with optional filtering and pagination.
- **List Assistants** (read-only): List all assistants in your VAPI organization.
- **List Provider Resources** (read-only): List provider resources from Vapi.
- **List Scorecards** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of scorecards from Vapi.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of sessions from VAPI.
- **List Structured Outputs**: List structured outputs with optional filtering.
- **List Structured Outputs** (read-only): List structured outputs with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Test Code Tool Execution**: Test TypeScript code execution in Vapi's code tool environment.
- **Update Eval**: Update an existing eval in Vapi.
- **Update Insight**: Update an existing insight configuration in VAPI.
- **Update Tool**: Update an existing Vapi tool configuration.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file to Vapi Knowledge Base.
